reason: The functional change is a small, low-risk TS/JS edit adding outcome titles to workflow nodes, but the PR bundles a large, unrelated dependency upgrade (Vue major version bump across esm/global/runtime bundles) and many regenerated minified/map assets, which is hard to fully verify in an automated gate and could introduce subtle admin-UI regressions.
